'''Devlin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] Devlin was in command of the [[First Recon]], a unit that participated in the [[Invasion of Belsavis]]. They went on to investigate the [[Deep caverns]] in [[The Tomb]], but most of the soldiers were overrrun and captured by the [[Esh-kha]]. Devlin himself escape imprisonment and managed to convinced a Republic agent in the area to rescue his men.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Devlin appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where he begins the mission "Riot."
